paragraphs: Hyman reports him in the old printings at Shabbat 17a, whereas the text Hyman uses reads Avimi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Shabbat 17b reads אמר באלי אמר אבימי סנוותאה. Hyman cites 17a and supplies Avivi Sagvata for old printings. His report of those printings is distinct from this digital witness.

The named William Davidson Shabbat 17b paragraph writes Avimi Sinvataa (אבימי סנוותאה). Hyman’s Avivi Sagvata (אביבי סגוותאה), his 17a locator and his statement about old printings remain distinct. The old printings have not been freshly inspected, and no Avivi/Avimi or gentilic identity equivalence is admitted. The existing note remains unchanged; no further people or legal statements from the selected paragraph are added.
